name: Lingen (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, yellow and red with a broad yellow middle stripe, charged at the centre with the full achievement of the city arms of Lingen (Ems) (a red shield with a castle supported by two lions).
history: Municipal flag of Lingen; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.
